title: Chemical Cleaners vs. Drainage Pipes
description: Many homeowners and property managers believe pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a clogged line is a quick, safe fix. However, chemical cleaners rely on strong exothermic reactions or heavy corrosive agents that generate extreme heat. In PVC drain-waste-vent systems, this localized heat can soften plastic walls, degrade pipe cement at joints, and weaken fittings over time. Furthermore, standing chemical solutions pose severe safety hazards to technicians performing subsequent repairs. For reliable long-term drainage maintenance, professional mechanical clearing, such as using a drain auger or hydro-jetter, clears blockages safely without compromising pipe integrity or violating local safety standards.
